items.text: Hi everyone!
This patch adds tropical flip-flops to your shoe rental selection while bringing a focused round of improvements to arcade audio, employee navigation, item visuals, and everyday interactions.
Tropical Flip-Flops
Unlocks at Level 8
$750 for eight pairs
Visibly worn by customers
Refreshed Pinball Machine sound effects.
Improved Claw Machine spatial audio.
Arcade sounds now respond correctly to SFX volume.
Improved cook reach for wall-shelf food.
Improved employee navigation around wall shelves.
Fixed trim above lane ends.
Fixed Sparkling Water blocking other shelves.
Improved Sparkling Water transparency.
Fixed empty Marinara Sauce visuals.
Prevented accidental left-click cash collection.
Thank you for continuing to play and share your feedback. We hope the new Tropical Flip-Flops bring some extra beach-day style to your alley while these fixes make everything a little smoother!

releases.displayName: Performance Takes Center Lane: Smoother Alleys and Smarter Party Rooms

items.text: Hi everyone!

This update focuses on making Bowling Alley Simulator run more smoothly, especially in large alleys filled with customers and employees. We’ve also improved party-room behavior, reworked the Free Labor skill, and fixed several interface issues.
Optimized customers, employees, pro bowlers and other characters.
Improved performance when large crowds are visible.
Improved how the game handles rooms and buildings outside your view.
Reduced unnecessary rendering inside the bank and casino.

notes.title: Party rooms now behave more like private event spaces

items.text: Regular customers will no longer enter party rooms to use entertainment or vending machines.
Party guests can enjoy in-room entertainment before their first bowling game.
Party-only lane reservations clear after the group finishes, allowing regular customers to use the lane afterward.
Improved party guest movement and entertainment choices.
Fixed customers overlapping on dance floors.
The Free Labor skill now makes every employee perform at maximum skill without skipping their work animations.
Employees remain free and highly efficient, but cleaning, cooking and register tasks now look and behave more naturally.
Shops now display newly unlocked items correctly after leveling up.
Purchase buttons update immediately when your cash balance changes.
Improved text entry for signs, save names, business names and prices.
Customers are more likely to use a variety of arcade games rather than the same ones.
Employees and customers are less likely to walk toward unreachable locations.
Cooks no longer interrupt hot dogs another employee is already preparing.
Added further fixes for entertainment, storage, deliveries and lane reservations.
Fixed lanes 13/14 displaying out of order.
Fixed a bug that caused customers to get stuck walking around row seating.
Thank you to everyone who has sent us performance reports and feedback. We hope this update makes your busiest nights at the alley feel noticeably smoother.

topNew: Optimized customers, employees, pro bowlers and other characters.
Improved performance when large crowds are visible.
Improved how the game handles rooms and buildings outside your view.

releases.displayName: Lane Reservations, Key Rebinding & Arcade Improvements Update

items.text: Hello everyone!

We've been hard at work since our last update, and today's patch introduces one of our most requested features alongside a variety of gameplay improvements, new decorations, and quality-of-life updates.
Take control of your bowling alley with the new Lane Reservation system!
Reserve lanes for Pro Bowlers, Party Guests, or both
New reservation menu with rope signs
Employees respect lane reservations when assigning groups
Reservations are saved with your game and update front-desk availability automatically
Fixed ghost groups blocking the front-desk queue
We've continued polishing the arcade experience.
Improved arcade cabinet animations, screens, and soundtrack behavior
Added a new NPC arcade-playing animation
Fixed the claw machine
Updated the character animation controller
Give your bowling alley even more personality.
Added BOWL, Strike, Live Laugh Bowl, and Washroom neon signs
Added new flower, rectangle, square, and round rugs
Mushroom Lights are now paintable
Added placement-direction arrows to stools
Furniture withdrawn from storage can now be placed into your hotbar and restored correctly after loading
Added full keybinding remapping with conflict detection
Improved keyboard and gamepad input hints
Increased the maximum look sensitivity from 5 to 10
Cooks now plan and claim workable orders more intelligently
Cooks switch to stocked container stations when another runs out
Improved order badge accuracy and idle-cook task sharing
Fixed late reviews and checkout activity being counted toward the wrong day
Customers now finish their game of bowling and wait for their food order even after midnight
Added localized phone call subtitles
Improved pace of bowling games, customers finish their games more quickly
The next bowler now prepares while the previous ball is still settling
Increased revenue progression in mid-late game; making money is now a bit easier
Thank you for all the feedback and suggestions! We're continuing to improve every part of the game and have even more features in the works. As always, let us know what you'd like to see next!

topNew: We've continued polishing the arcade experience.

releases.displayName: New Content, Major Fixes & Quality-of-Life Update

items.text: This update brings a large batch of new content, quality-of-life improvements, balance adjustments, and bug fixes across nearly every part of the game.
Thank you to everyone who has been reporting bugs and sharing feedback, it has helped shape this update!
Added the Angled Shoe Shelf
Added the Bench with Storage
Added the Round Lounge Table
Added Medium and Large Pictures
The Trash Compactor is now fully functional with animations and sound effects
The Coffee Maker can now brew coffee and includes new visuals, sounds, and a cup stand
Added operating sounds to the Hot Dog Roller
Added descriptions to bowling balls, shoes, lane themes, and decorative pins
Added separate Horizontal and Vertical invert-look settings
Added a hint explaining that you can carry up to three small items
Furniture boxes can now be saved directly to the hotbar while placing them
Hovering over a furniture box now shows its contents
Prices can now be entered directly through the Management PC
Debit terminals now support decimals, backspace, and clear controls
"Quit" has been replaced with "Save & Quit"
Autosaves now display their day and time
Closing the game from the desktop now creates an autosave
Employees perform routine actions faster
Food now spoils 30% more slowly
Customer traffic and food demand increase more gradually during the first week
Food lines begin with a smaller capacity and expand over time
Customers generally arrive happier, making tips easier to earn
Large condiment combinations are less common
Extremely cheap or expensive pricing can now generate positive or negative reviews
Overpricing has a much smaller effect on customer traffic
Income now scales with progression, reaching up to +50% at Level 7
Parties now provide a $20 booking fee per guest
Pro bowlers are now more accurate
Forest lane themes unlock at Level 4
Medieval lane themes unlock at Level 5
Cosmic lane themes unlock at Level 6
Premium pin designs are now spread across later levels
Shops now refresh newly unlocked items without requiring a reload
Fixed cooks failing to collect food from high shelves and freezers
Fixed cooks consuming stock for cancelled orders
Cooks now report missing food, appliances, containers, and condiments
Improved cook navigation around kitchen equipment and freezer doors
Cooks no longer wait in cashier positions
Fixed cashiers incorrectly treating high-shelf stock as unreachable
Customers can leave long food lines when it's their turn to bowl
Fixed customers visiting the bathroom during their bowling turn
Party guests now use available lanes sooner
Standing party guests can bowl when all seats are occupied
Fixed party groups attempting to claim the same lane
The tutorial party call can no longer expire
Fixed customers becoming stranded after closing or on sidewalks
Fixed "ghost" customers appearing after loading
Fixed customers breaking when furniture they were sitting on was removed
Fixed NPCs attempting to bowl on jammed lanes
Fixed bowling balls teleporting when the ball return activated
Fixed customers failing to return rental shoes after loading
Rental shoes now return in the correct size
Shoes are refunded if checkout is interrupted by closing time
Fixed duplicate reviews from pro bowlers
Corrected multiple bowling lane rendering and scene issues
Fixed issues affecting snack shelves, heating lamps, coffee cups, juice boxes, and several food items
Empty coffee cup stands can now be discarded and replaced
Fixed removed items remaining registered inside containers
Shelf items no longer fall when your hands or held box are full
Food now resumes spoiling correctly after leaving refrigeration
Fixed food disappearing from furniture and trays after loading
Loose objects now wait for furniture to load before being restored
Fixed older furniture names causing placed furniture to disappear
Furniture that temporarily fails to load is preserved for another recovery attempt
Fixed saves erasing furniture while it was still loading
Delivery boxes that fall through the world now return to the delivery area
Dropped items are less likely to fall through floors and walls
The Large Workbench now correctly blocks customer navigation
The one-time Vending Machine can no longer be permanently discarded
Fixed garbage bin restrictions and outdoor dumpster behavior
Fixed the pause menu interfering with registers and PCs
Fixed debit payments becoming stuck when started from another camera view
Health inspection reports now wait for other menus to close
Improved the new game form on ultrawide displays
Fixed excessive signature scribbling causing UI errors
Fixed errors when removing a slot machine during a spin
Fixed dispenser information showing details from the previous station
Improved overlapping positional audio
Fixed checkout errors that could occur at closing time
Improved the end-of-day unlock display
Reduced duplicate and lingering tutorial hints

Thank you again to everyone who has been playing, reporting bugs, and sharing feedback. Your support helps us improve the game with every update, and we're excited to keep bringing you even more content!
